verdict: Paid ads went dark 12 days ago; GBP is holding but cannot fill the gap.
narrative: Meta campaigns stopped spending on August 6th and have run at $0 since — no paid leads have been generated in the 12 days since. Over the full 28-day window, you received 45 leads at $26.04 per lead while campaigns were active, so the pipeline is not empty, but new paid lead flow is paused. Your Google Business Profile continues to drive organic activity — 55 calls and 161 total actions this period — though that channel also slowed in the most recent week and cannot replace paid volume on its own. Campaigns are being reactivated, and the priority is restoring consistent daily spend before the pipeline gap widens further.
